title: Improved Dimension Dependence for Bandit Convex Optimization with Gradient Variations
abstract: arXiv:2602.04761v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Gradient-variation online learning has drawn increasing attention due to its deep connections to game theory and optimization. It has been studied extensively in the full-information setting, but is underexplored with bandit feedback. In this work, we focus on gradient variation in Bandit Convex Optimization (BCO) with two-point feedback. By proposing a refined analysis of the non-consecutive gradient variation, a fundamental quantity in gradient variation with bandit feedback, we improve the dimension dependence for both convex and strongly convex functions compared with the best known results (Chiang et al., 2013). Our improved analysis of the non-consecutive gradient variation also implies other favorable problem-dependent guarantees, such as gradient-variance and small-loss regret bounds. Beyond the two-point setup, we demonstrate the versatility of our technique by achieving the first gradient-variation bound for one-point bandi

translated_title: 梯度变化下赌博机凸优化的维度依赖性改进
translated_abstract: 梯度变化在线学习由于与博弈论和优化的深刻联系而受到越来越多的关注。该问题已在全信息设置下得到广泛研究，但在赌博机反馈下的研究仍然不足。在这项工作中，我们关注带两点反馈的赌博机凸优化（BCO）中的梯度变化问题。通过对非连续梯度变化（赌博机反馈下梯度变化中的一个基本量）提出精细化的分析，我们相比已知最佳结果（Chiang et al., 2013）改进了凸函数和强凸函数情形下的维度依赖性。我们对非连续梯度变化的改进分析还蕴含了其他有利的问题依赖性保证，例如梯度方差遗憾界和小损失遗憾界。除两点反馈设置之外，我们通过在单点赌博机反馈下实现首个梯度变化界，展示了我们技术的通用性。
tldr: 本文通过对非连续梯度变化的精细化分析，改进了带两点反馈的赌博机凸优化中凸函数和强凸函数梯度变化遗憾界的维度依赖性，并首次实现了单点赌博机反馈下的梯度变化界。
en_tdlr: This paper improves the dimension dependence of gradient-variation regret bounds for bandit convex optimization with two-point feedback through a refined analysis of non-consecutive gradient variation, and achieves the first gradient-variation bound for one-point bandit feedback.
